prior_findings_closure.property: Journal budgets and complete attempt publication
prior_findings_closure.evidence: Bounded regular JSONL journal, nonblocking lock, immutable run/deadline/caps, sequential attempt/result replay and sticky uncertainty persist. Complete write loops and fsync precede launch; zero/error-after-prefix paths refuse. This does not assert power-loss durability, journal tamper resistance or kernel-call interruption.

Entry clocks anchor the monotonic budget; admission rechecks after validation/replay/attempt publication and immediately before Popen prevent stale admission. Exact-child wait, bounded TERM/KILL cleanup, group-remainder refusal, interruption and unchanged post-pins are retained. Postcondition validation cannot return successful completion beyond the command budget. Relevant passing real-process and injected-boundary tests were inspected.
